svg.text: Proposal, not running UI · reference: NetworkManager, with a clearer flow · uses the accepted neutral surfaces, 8/12 radii, Inter and Hack
Wired · 1 Gb/s · DHCP · up for 3 h 12 min
DNS slow for 2 min, then recovered
What works, step by step, from this machine outward
DNS is slower than usual. Pages may open late, though everything still works.
Applying keeps the old settings until the new ones connect.
Better than a list of profiles
Opens on an answer in plain words: are you online, and how.
Connections are grouped by kind, and absent hardware says so
Technical details stay one glance away, not behind a dialog.
Traffic for the last minute, hour, day and week, kept within
A history of what happened: renewals, drops, slow DNS, in
Each event can open the traffic graph at that moment.
Diagnostics checks each step from adapter to secure web, and
stops guessing at the first real failure.
It suggests one concrete fix and explains the effect.
A changed connection keeps the old settings until the new
ones connect, so a typo cannot strand you.
Requires: traffic counters and event history in the network service, an edit service for root, ping and trace. Wi-Fi and VPN need drivers and services that do not exist yet. Values are illustrative.
